name: Vastra Gotaland County (Sweden)

colors.symbolism: the lions of Göteborg and Västergötland, and the gold half of the Västergötland quarter
the fields of the Bohuslän and Dalsland quarters, and the waves of the Göteborg quarter
the fortress of Bohuslän and the ox of Dalsland
the wavy field of the Göteborg quarter and the lion supporters of Bohuslän
the sable half of the Västergötland quarter

description: A square banner of the county arms, quartered: the gold lion of Göteborg with the Three Crowns shield on blue and white waves; the red fortress of Bohuslän between blue lions on white; the red ox of Dalsland on white; and the lion of Västergötland counterchanged on gold and black.
history: Vastra Gotaland County was formed on 1 January 1998 by the merger of Goteborg and Bohus, Alvsborg, and Skaraborg counties. The county arms were granted in 1999 and the flag is the heraldic banner of those arms.

features.role: arms of Västra Götaland County: Göteborg, Bohuslän, Dalsland and Västergötland
features.symbolism: the county arms quarter the devices of the city of Göteborg and the historic provinces of Bohuslän, Dalsland and Västergötland that make up Västra Götaland

features.role: lion of Göteborg holding the Three Crowns shield
fortress of Bohuslän with blue lion supporters
